presets.title: Built-in filters
presets.description: A car's gyro yaw rate from the SZE-JKK dataset: as recorded, through the built-in moving-average filter, and integrated into its heading.

presets.title: ANYmal GrandTour
presets.description: A legged robot walking a forest trail: its three cameras, the lidar scan around its model, beside its joints, IMU and speed.

presets.title: Self-driving car
presets.description: A car on a suburban road in Silicon Valley from PandaSet: its six cameras with 3D-box overlays, its lidar and the boxes in 3D.

presets.title: Office robot
presets.description: A wheeled robot driving room to room in an office, from LILocBench: its camera, depth cloud and laser scans on the floor map.

presets.title: Racing drone
presets.description: A racing quadrotor flying laps through the gates of an indoor track at up to 42 km/h, from UZH-FPV: its fisheye and event cameras and its racing line in 3D.
